fix: build with Node.js 22.23.5 from one .node-version file

Astro 7.4.12 exits on Node.js below 22.23.4. The engines range still
allowed 22.22.3, the README told Render to pin NODE_VERSION=22.22.3,
and CI asked setup-node for "22", which resolves to whatever 22 release
the runner has. The staging landing site builds on 22.22.3, so its next
release fails at astro build. Production sets no NODE_VERSION and
resolved the unbounded engines branch to Node.js 26.13.1.

.node-version now holds 22.23.5, the newest 22 release and a security
release. Every CI job that installs or runs the site reads it through
node-version-file, and Render reads it on both sites when no
NODE_VERSION variable is set. The release jobs keep node-version 22:
they only call the Render API, and the commit they check out can
predate .node-version. The engines floor moves to Astro's minimum,
^22.23.4. The README build contract names .node-version.

Tracks thomasluizon/orbit-tickets#2074

chore(deps): remove the esbuild override that no package uses

Astro 7.4.12 no longer depends on esbuild, and Vite lists it only as an
optional peer, so no esbuild package is in the lockfile. The override
pinned nothing. npm audit still reports any esbuild that a later
dependency adds.
docs: name the files that hold the Node.js version instead of copying their values

chore(deps): remove the vite override so Astro resolves Vite inside its range

Astro 7.4.12 requires vite ^8.3.6. The exact override 8.1.6 forced a Vite outside that range and a second Rolldown copy. Without it npm resolves vite 8.3.8 and one rolldown 1.2.19. The override was the floor for GHSA-rq7h-c2jc-7f22; every version in ^8.3.6 is above the patched 8.3.3.

perf: keep the home page startup scripts inside the budget on Vite 8.3

Vite 8.3 ships a larger dynamic import preload helper. Three reductions keep the script graph below the earlier figure:

- The preload lists keep only chunks that start a request. A chunk in the importer's static graph is already loaded, and import() requests its own chunk in the same task when no stylesheet waits.
- The pricing copy helpers move to src/config/pricing-copy.ts, which only the deferred pricing script and the server page import.
- applyTranslations sets the page language once.

perf: remove the unused pricing keys from the landing copy tables

The landing tables spread pricingCopy, but only pricingFor reads those six
keys, and it reads pricingCopy directly. The minifier kept the spread in
the startup i18n chunk, so the home page script graph is 32 bytes smaller.

refactor: remove the unreachable stylesheet branch from the preload plugin

Vite 8.3.8 appends a lazy chunk's stylesheets after resolveDependencies returns, so the branch that kept the target's own preload never ran. Both plugin comments now link the upstream Vite and Astro sources.

refactor: import the pricing module through its sibling path

pricing-copy.ts lives in src/config, so it imports ./pricing, the same way
src/i18n/demo-copy.ts imports ./translations.

The landing composition harness resolved every specifier from src/scripts,
so ./pricing loaded src/scripts/pricing.ts and recursed until the stack
overflowed. The harness now resolves each specifier from the folder of the
file that imports it, as Node and Vite do.
